Ralph Hastings: Hi everyone! I’m Ralph — joined yesterday on infra team. Bringing a box of sourdough bagels tomorrow morning if anyone’s around. Also curious where folks leave spare plant water bottles? My desk plant is notoriously dramatic. :seedling: 

Juno (People Ops): Welcome, Ralph!! :tada: Love the bagels. We usually set up in the 4th-floor kitchen at 10am for casual things — drop yours there and add a sticky note if it’s labelled for early birds. Plant water bottles usually live on the big shelf by the sink. 

Avery: Welcome! I’ll be there around 9:45 — coffee first, then bagel second. If you want low-key company, meet at the bench by 4B desks. :coffee:

Sam: Hi Ralph — FYI some folks keep extra 250ml spray bottles in the green bin next to the window. Works great for dramatic plants. Also desk number for mail is 4B-12 if you’re getting any packages.

Zoe: Welcome welcome!! If your plant acts up mid-day, shout in #eng-plant-care — we have an unofficial watering rota and a plant whisperer who brings aloe every other week. :herb:

Ralph Hastings: Amazing — thanks y’all. I’ll drop bagels at 10 like Juno said and leave a note about my favorite spread (everything cream cheese, no judgment). Also I’ll put a small watering can on my desk and add it to the shelf after. 

DevInfra Bot: Reminder: new-hire desk access card setup is pending for Ralph Hastings. Please confirm with Juno if you need immediate floor-swipe.

Juno (People Ops): Thanks for the heads-up, Bot. Ralph — card should be active by 9am tomorrow. Ping me if not and I’ll manually enable. Also we do a tiny welcome slack chant in #general at 10:05, want me to include your bagel shoutout? :smile_cat:

Ralph Hastings: Yes please include it! Might bribe people into saying hi. :grin:

Avery: See you tomorrow! If you’ve got a favorite playlist, bring it — we have a communal speaker near the kitchen. 

Sam: Also quick plant tip — clippings propagate well in a jar of water if you want backups. Happy to show you sometime. 

Zoe: See you at bagels. Welcome again, Ralph! :party_popper:
